A scroll whose columns hold no characters:

```scroll {rows=0 cols=2 lang=tsu map=tengchou .nativefont}
chen teng
```

A scroll in a script written in lines:

```scroll {rows=3 lang=vyl font=semaron-kuriale map=vyl-semaron .nativefont}
thirun sorima
```
